abstract: BACKGROUND: Human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG)-producing large or giant cell carcinoma of the lung is not uncommon, but primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma is an extremely rare entity. Even rarer are cases occurring in males; to date the authors have found only 12 reported cases in the English literature. METHODS: The clinical record of a 61-year-old man who presented with hemoptysis is described. A review of the literature regarding patients with primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma also is reported. RESULTS: Computed tomography scan of the chest demonstrated an expanding thickness of the bullous wall within areas of emphysematous change in the lower lobe of the right lung. Moreover, a new, round tumor near the thickness appeared and rapidly expanded evenly into the surrounding lung tissue. Exploratory thoracotomy revealed the previous tumor to be adenocarcinoma with a small foci of choriocarcinoma, and the new tumor to be a hemorrhage with choriocarcinoma. Because of the pleural dissemination, the patient was treated with chemotherapy. At last follow-up he was alive and well with a gradually increasing serum hCG-beta level in spite of chemotherapy. CONCLUSIONS: Primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma occurring in men is an extremely rare entity with a fatal prognosis. Of the 12 cases reported to date in the English literature, 3 cases of choriocarcinoma with the coexistence of another type of pulmonary carcinoma were reported. To the authors' knowledge the clinical relation between these two types of carcinoma are unknown because all cases to date have been detected at the time of autopsy. Only in the current study case could the clinical course of the disease be followed and pathologic confirmation achieved, although the pathogenesis of the two types of carcinoma could not be determined.
abstract_ja:
背景：ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)産生性の大細胞癌や巨細胞癌は肺で珍しくないが、原発性肺絨毛癌は極めてまれである。男性例はさらにまれで、著者らが英文文献で見出したのは12例のみである。
方法：喀血で来院した61歳男性の臨床記録を記載する。原発性肺絨毛癌の患者に関する文献レビューも併せて報告する。
結果：胸部コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)では、気腫性変化の範囲内にある嚢胞壁の肥厚が拡大し、その近傍に新たな円形腫瘍が出現して周囲の肺組織へ急速かつ均一に広がっていた。開胸術では、以前からの腫瘍は小さな絨毛癌巣を伴う腺癌であり、新たな腫瘍は絨毛癌を伴う出血であった。胸膜播種があったため、患者は化学療法を受けた。最終追跡時点で患者は生存し健在であったが、化学療法にもかかわらず血清hCG-β値は徐々に上昇していた。
結論：男性に生じる原発性肺絨毛癌はきわめてまれで、予後は不良である。英文で報告された12例のうち3例では、絨毛癌と他の型の肺癌の併存が報告されていた。本症例は臨床経過を追跡でき、病理学的に確認できた唯一の例であるが、2種類の癌の発生機序は確定できなかった。
